messages.subject: lavTestScore question
parts:
Hi.
I am new in this group, and also new to lavaan and R.

I am doing measurement invariance testing of a latent construct for mental well-being across gender. I achieved metric invariance. When trying to test for partial strong invariance I am using the lavTestScore function. The output I get after freeing one parameter is however the same as when I ran the function initially. It doesn't seem like anything happened/that the parameter was actually freed. So I am thinking there must be a mistake in my code, but I can't figure it out. Any help is greatly appreciated!

Code:
###Checking for partial scalar invariance
lavTestScore(fit_scalar)

##Freeing first parameter
fit_scalar.x9 <- cfa(SMWB.model_s, data=BASMWBPYD.df, missing ="ml", estimator="MLR", group="Gender", group.equal = c( "loadings", "intercepts"), group.partial = c("x9 ~ 1"))
lavTestScore(fit_scalar.x9)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavTestScore question
parts:
Without seeing your syntax or model output, there isn't much to go on.  But try comparing your summary() output from both models to see if they are indeed statistically equivalent (same fit and df).

Your lavTestScore() output is consistent with a model that has only 7 indicators (there seem to be 6 constraints on loadings, because the first is already fixed to 1, and 7 constraints on intercepts).  Is "x9" really the name of one of your 7 indicators?  I think instead you want to free the 9th constraint in the table of univariate score tests, corresponding to the equality constraint: .p20. == .p45.
Look at your parTable() output to see which indicator's intercepts correspond to those parameter labels (in the "plabel" column).
